control_failures.control_label: dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - engineering change note not applied to TX-3001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on TX-3001 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically selecting isolation points and devices. TX-3001 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 8 November 2006 a planned spot check of TX-3001 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy not effective.
